_comment: Orders (#orders) grid control data and the QA-AUTO order used as a precondition, keyed by case ID. Load with loadFixture('orders', caseId). Filter/sort/pagination cases operate on the deterministic seeded grid (reseeded on full page reload). Search and Advance-status cases create their own QA-AUTO order via test/helpers/data/orders.ts so they never depend on pre-existing records.

TC-ORD-002._note: Create a QA-AUTO order via setupQaAutoOrder first, then search its unique customer token so there is a guaranteed, isolated match.

TC-ODTL-003._note: Precondition order for Advance status. Created in-test via setupQaAutoOrder; never advance a pre-existing order. New orders start in the first status (expected to be Queued), so Advance should move it to the next value.
TC-ODTL-003.deliveryNotes: QA-AUTO advance-status check - safe to delete
